versions.grouping_at_time: Subpart D — UAV Design and Construction
versions.text:
(a) Each part that has clearance (free fit) and that is subject to pounding or vibration, must have a bearing factor large enough to provide for the effects of normal relative motion.
(b) For control surface hinges and control system joints, compliance with the factors prescribed in USAR.657 and USAR.693 respectively, meets paragraph (a) .
